ops.summary: HTML to PDF, Markdown to PDF or URL/web page to PDF and PNG — Chromium-rendered with real fonts, CSS, page breaks, headers and footers. No text-to-PDF makeshift.

params.name: html
params.desc: HTML document or fragment to turn into a PDF or PNG. Send one of html, markdown or url; if several are sent, url wins over markdown over html and X-BigAPI-Warnings says which one was used.
params.default_note: none, send exactly one of html, markdown or url

params.name: markdown
params.desc: Markdown text to render with GitHub-flavoured rules (tables, task lists, fenced code). Use it instead of html when the agent wrote Markdown.
params.default_note: none, send exactly one of html, markdown or url

params.name: url
params.desc: Public http(s) address of a web page to print, e.g. to archive it. Our browser in Germany loads it; pages behind a login cannot be reached.
params.default_note: none, send exactly one of html, markdown or url

params.name: css
params.desc: Extra CSS added before printing, e.g. to hide a cookie banner or change fonts. Leave it out to print the page as it is.
params.default_note: none, the page keeps its own styles

params.name: format
params.desc: Output file: pdf for documents to send or archive, png for an image of the page.

params.name: pdf
params.desc: Page setup for PDF output, as an object: format (paper size: A4, Letter, Legal, A3 …), landscape (true for wide pages), margin ({top, right, bottom, left} with units, e.g. "10mm"), printBackground (false drops background colours and images), scale (0.1 to 2).
params.default_note: A4 portrait, margins 20 mm top and bottom and 18 mm left and right, backgrounds printed, scale 1

params.name: png
params.desc: Image size for PNG output, as an object: width and height of the browser window in pixels, fullPage (false captures only the visible window), deviceScaleFactor (2 for sharp images on high-resolution screens).

params.name: waitUntil
params.desc: When to take the snapshot. networkidle0: wait until the page has made no network requests for 500 ms; safest for pages that load content with JavaScript, slowest. networkidle2: allow up to 2 open requests; use it when analytics or a chat widget never go quiet. load: all images, styles and scripts loaded. domcontentloaded: HTML read only; fastest, but images and web fonts may be missing.
params.default_note: networkidle0 for url, load for html and markdown

params.name: timeoutMs
params.desc: How long to wait for the page, in milliseconds, before giving up with an error. Raise it for slow pages; values above 60000 are capped at 60000.

ops.summary: Combine two or more PDFs into one, in the order given.

params.name: files
params.desc: Two or more PDF files, combined in the order sent. Multipart field name: files[].

ops.summary: Split a PDF or delete pages: keep ranges like 1-3,7,9-z in a new file — extract pages, remove pages, cut a document apart.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to take pages from.

params.name: pages
params.desc: Pages to keep, e.g. 1-3,7 or 5-z (z is the last page). To delete pages, list the ones you want to keep. Spaces are ignored; 5-1 gives the pages in reverse order. A page that does not exist (0, or beyond the last page) returns 400 invalid_pages with an explanation.

ops.summary: One PDF with many scanned receipts in, one PDF per receipt out (ZIP). Splits at blank pages, at separator sheets with a QR code or every n pages; blank pages and separators are dropped, files named by invoice number.

params.name: file
params.desc: The collective PDF, e.g. a stack of receipts from the document scanner. Up to 300 pages.

params.name: by
params.desc: auto: blank pages and separator sheets; blank: only blank pages; separator: only separator sheets with a QR code; pages: fixed every every_pages pages.

params.name: every_pages
params.desc: Only for by=pages: pages per document (1 to 100).

params.name: separator_text
params.desc: Text in the QR code of the separator sheet.

params.name: output
params.desc: zip: the receipts as PDFs, the plan in the header X-BigAPI-Documents; json: only the plan (pages per document, invoice number, date, removed pages).

ops.summary: Rotate all or selected pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF whose pages should be turned.

params.name: angle
params.desc: Clockwise rotation in degrees: 90 turns a quarter to the right, 180 turns upside down, 270 turns a quarter to the left.

params.name: pages
params.desc: Pages to rotate, e.g. 1,3-4 (z is the last page). All other pages stay as they are. Spaces are ignored; 5-1 gives the pages in reverse order. A page that does not exist (0, or beyond the last page) returns 400 invalid_pages with an explanation.

ops.summary: Reduce PDF file size (REST API: files up to 100 MB): downsample images to shrink a PDF for mail or web — quality levels screen, ebook, printer, prepress. A PDF that needs a password to open gets 422 encrypted_pdf.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to make smaller.

params.name: level
params.desc: How strongly to shrink images inside the PDF. screen: smallest file, images around 72 dpi, fine for on-screen reading. ebook: good balance, around 150 dpi. printer: around 300 dpi for office printing. prepress: around 300 dpi keeping colour profiles, for professional print. Text and vector graphics stay sharp at every level.

ops.summary: PDF to images: rasterise pages as JPEG or PNG (PDF to JPG, PDF to PNG), 36–600 dpi, one image or a ZIP — for thumbnails, previews and vision models.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to turn into images, one image per page.

params.name: dpi
params.desc: Image resolution from 36 to 600. 150 suits screens and previews, 300 suits print or OCR; higher values give larger files.

params.name: first
params.desc: First page to convert (1 is the first page).

params.name: last
params.desc: Last page to convert.

params.name: format
params.desc: Image type: jpeg for small files and photos, png for crisp text and diagrams without compression artefacts.

params.name: quality
params.desc: JPEG quality; lower values give smaller files with visible artefacts. Ignored for png.

ops.summary: Resize, crop, convert (incl. HEIC from iPhones), compress, blur and strip metadata in one call — or use a preset like web, thumbnail or og.

params.name: file
params.desc: Source image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, or HEIC/HEIF from an iPhone).

params.name: ops
params.desc: What to do, as a JSON object; combine freely. resize: {width, height, fit}, fit inside (default) shrinks without cropping, cover fills the box and crops, contain fits with borders. crop: {left, top, width, height} in px. rotate: degrees. format: jpeg, png, webp, avif, tiff or gif to convert. quality: 1 to 100 for jpeg, webp and avif. palette: true for smaller PNGs with fewer colours. watermark: {text, position, opacity}. keepMetadata: true keeps EXIF and colour profile. blur: strength 0.3 to 100 (or true for 10) to blur the whole image. preset: one word instead of several steps: web, thumbnail, avatar, og, email or print; your own keys override the preset. Unknown keys are rejected with an explanation.

params.name: watermark
params.desc: Optional second image placed as a watermark, e.g. a logo; position and opacity come from ops.watermark.

ops.summary: Format, size as displayed (EXIF rotation applied), colour space, alpha, density, frames, plus camera, capture time and GPS location from EXIF. iPhone photos report format heic.

params.name: file
params.desc: Image to inspect: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF; HEIC/HEIF from iPhones is accepted too (EXIF and location are read from the original).

ops.summary: Embed C2PA Content Credentials into a JPEG/PNG/WebP and mark it as AI-generated (EU AI Act Art. 50). Signed with the BiGapi certificate of Artoption GmbH; name the creator with author.

params.name: file
params.desc: JPEG, PNG or WebP; HEIC/HEIF from iPhones is accepted too.

params.name: title
params.desc: Title written into the Content Credentials; C2PA viewers show it.

params.name: aiGenerated
params.desc: true marks the image as AI-generated (IPTC digital source type trainedAlgorithmicMedia), as Art. 50 EU AI Act expects for AI output. Set false to sign an image made by a person.

params.name: generator
params.desc: Name of the software or model that made the image, e.g. "Midjourney v7"; recorded in the credentials.

params.name: author
params.desc: Creator named in the credentials, e.g. "Redaktion Nordblick" or "Studio Mira", up to 120 characters; recorded as dc:creator in a CAWG metadata assertion. The signature itself stays with BiGapi (Artoption GmbH); own certificates or private keys are not accepted.

portal.blocked: Jeder könnte Bilder mit „signiert von Artoption GmbH“ versehen

ops.summary: Read and validate C2PA Content Credentials of an image: who signed, which generator, is it marked AI-generated.

params.name: file
params.desc: Image whose Content Credentials (C2PA) should be checked; the answer also says when there are none.

ops.summary: Read barcodes and 2D codes (EAN, UPC, Code 128, QR, DataMatrix, PDF417) from a photo or PDF: type, content, position; GS1 labels split into GTIN, batch, dates, SSCC.

params.name: file
params.desc: Photo or scan (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF) or a PDF of up to 20 pages, e.g. a shipping label, delivery note or product packaging.

params.name: first
params.desc: PDF only: first page to read.

params.name: last
params.desc: PDF only: last page to read (at most 20 pages per call).
params.default_note: last page of the PDF (up to 20 pages from first)

ops.summary: Stamp a visible "AI-generated" label onto an image and write it into the metadata: EXIF description plus the IPTC DigitalSourceType that platforms read. The 1-cent bulk tile for EU AI Act labelling.

params.name: file
params.desc: JPEG, PNG or WebP; HEIC/HEIF from iPhones is accepted too.

params.name: text
params.desc: Label printed on the image, up to 60 characters.

params.name: position
params.desc: Corner for the label.

params.name: kind
params.desc: How the image was made, written as IPTC DigitalSourceType: generated = trainedAlgorithmicMedia, edited = compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia.

params.name: format
params.desc: Output format; leave it out to keep the input format.

ops.summary: Full-page or viewport screenshot of a URL with device presets. The render tile already does this; this tile is the simpler front door agents search for.

params.name: url
params.desc: Public URL to capture.

params.name: device
params.desc: Browser window preset: desktop 1440 × 900, laptop 1280 × 800, tablet 834 × 1112 with touch and double resolution, mobile 390 × 844 with touch and triple resolution.

params.name: fullPage
params.desc: Capture the whole page instead of just the viewport.

params.name: format
params.desc: Image type: png for crisp text, jpeg for smaller files (see quality).

params.name: quality
params.desc: JPEG quality from 30 to 100; lower values give smaller files. Ignored for png.

params.name: width
params.desc: Overrides the window width of the device preset, in px, up to 3840.

params.name: height
params.desc: Overrides the window height of the device preset, in px, up to 2160.

params.name: delayMs
params.desc: Extra wait after the page has loaded, in ms, up to 10000; use it for animations or content that appears late.

portal.blocked: Webadresse: das Portal wäre ein kostenloser Scraper und Proxy für jeden

ops.summary: OCR for scanned PDFs and photos: image to text, scan to searchable PDF, extract text from pictures — 14 languages incl. Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi and Russian (default German + English). Billed per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: Scanned PDF or image (PNG, JPEG, TIFF).

params.name: lang
params.desc: Languages of the document as Tesseract codes, joined with + (up to 4), e.g. fra+eng. Installed: ara, chi_sim, deu, eng, fra, hin, ind, ita, jpn, nld, por, rus, spa, vie. Setting the real language matters: without it Cyrillic, Devanagari, Chinese, Japanese and Arabic are not recognised at all. Codes that are not installed are dropped with a warning (unknown_language); if none is left, deu+eng is used.

params.name: output
params.desc: Searchable PDF, plain text, or JSON with text per page.

params.name: dpi
params.desc: Resolution used to read PDF pages, 100 to 600. Raise it for very small print; higher is slower. Ignored for images.

ops.summary: Word to PDF, Excel to PDF, PowerPoint to PDF: convert DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT and more via LibreOffice. With accessible=true the PDF is tagged for PDF/UA-1, with title, language and display settings fixed. Billed per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, ODT, ODS, ODP, RTF, CSV or TXT.

params.name: accessible
params.desc: true exports a tagged PDF for PDF/UA-1 (accessible PDF): structure tags, document title (from the file properties, else the first line), language detected from the text, title shown in the viewer. Images without alternative text and tables without a header row are reported in X-BigAPI-Warnings and X-BigAPI-A11y, because only the author can fix them in the source.

ops.summary: Archival PDF/A with embedded fonts and normalised colours: PDF/A-2b, or PDF/A-3b when the file has attachments (e-invoices stay valid). Removes JavaScript; warns when a signature is lost.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to convert into an archival PDF/A-2b file with embedded fonts and colour profile.

params.name: part
params.desc: auto makes PDF/A-3b when the PDF has embedded files (they are kept, an embedded ZUGFeRD/Factur-X invoice gets its XMP schema), otherwise PDF/A-2b. 2 removes attachments.

ops.summary: Check a PDF for accessibility: PDF/UA-1 machine check with veraPDF plus a precheck for what veraPDF misses (missing headings, tables without header row, wrong language). Verdict, findings and failed rules as JSON.

params.name: file
params.desc: The PDF to check, e.g. a report, form or brochure that has to be accessible.

params.name: norm
params.desc: false skips the veraPDF run and returns only the fast precheck.

ops.summary: Fix what accessibility checks often find: document title (also in XMP), title shown in the viewer, language (detected from the text), tagged flag and tab order. Open issues come back in X-BigAPI-A11y.

params.name: file
params.desc: The PDF to fix.

params.name: title
params.desc: Document title, up to 300 characters.
params.default_note: the existing title; if there is none, the first line of text, else the file name

params.name: lang
params.desc: Document language as a BCP 47 tag such as de-DE or en-GB, or auto to detect it from the text (11 languages; the existing language stays if detection is unsure).

ops.summary: Turn Markdown (e.g. an LLM answer) into a formatted Word document – headings, lists, tables, links. Send JSON {markdown} or upload a .md file.

params.name: markdown
params.desc: GitHub-flavoured Markdown. Alternatively upload a .md file as multipart field "file".

ops.summary: Check PDF signatures: who signed, when, unchanged or not, verified with the signer certificate's key (RSA, PSS, ECDSA). No CA trust-chain check. Locked or damaged PDFs get 422.

params.name: file
params.desc: Signed PDF to check: who signed, when, and whether it was changed afterwards.

ops.summary: Save an email as PDF, from .eml or Outlook .msg: header table, body, inline images, forwarded messages; attachments embedded as files.

params.name: file
params.desc: E-mail saved as .eml or Outlook .msg file; header, text and attachments go into the PDF.

params.name: pageFormat
params.desc: Paper size of the PDF.

params.name: remoteImages
params.desc: Load external images (http/https). Off by default: newsletter tracking pixels would otherwise be fetched from our server. JavaScript in e-mails never runs.

params.name: embed
params.desc: Embed the attachments as files in the PDF (up to 25 MB in total); false only lists them.

ops.summary: Read bank statements from online banking (CAMT.053/052/054, MT940) into transactions with counterparty, IBAN, purpose and SEPA references; checks the balances add up. Also as a DATEV booking batch.

params.name: file
params.desc: Statement file as downloaded from online banking: CAMT XML (.xml) or MT940 text (.sta, .txt, .mt940). Not a PDF statement.

params.name: output
params.desc: json for agents; xlsx with sheets 'Buchungen' and 'Übersicht'; csv with semicolons and decimal commas for German Excel; datev: DATEV booking batch (EXTF Buchungsstapel, Windows-1252) for the tax adviser, one row per booked transaction.

params.name: bank_account
params.desc: Only for output=datev. Ledger account of the bank (Konto column), e.g. 1200.
params.default_note: 1200 with skr=03, 1800 with skr=04 (with a warning), else empty

params.name: contra_account
params.desc: Only for output=datev. Clearing account for transactions no rule matches (Gegenkonto), e.g. 1590. Without it, Gegenkonto stays empty and a warning says how many.

params.name: rules
params.desc: Only for output=datev. JSON list, first match wins: [{"name":"Telekom","account":"4920"},{"iban":"DE...","account":"3400"},{"purpose":"Miete","account":"4210"}]. name and purpose match if contained (any case), iban exactly. Up to 200 rules.

params.name: skr
params.desc: Only for output=datev. Chart of accounts; written to the header and used for the default bank account.

params.name: consultant
params.desc: Only for output=datev. DATEV Beraternummer (1001 to 9999999).

params.name: client
params.desc: Only for output=datev. DATEV Mandantennummer (1 to 99999).

params.name: account_length
params.desc: Only for output=datev. Length of ledger account numbers (4 to 8).

params.name: fiscal_year_start
params.desc: Only for output=datev. Start of the fiscal year as YYYY-MM-DD. Needed when the statement covers two calendar years; bookings outside that year give datev_outside_year.

ops.summary: Extract text from a PDF: clean, reflowed Markdown for LLM context, summaries or RAG. Scanned pages are read by OCR automatically (warning ocr_applied). Billed per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to read. Pages without a text layer (scans) are read by OCR, up to 50 such pages; the warning ocr_applied names them. Pages that stay empty are reported as no_text_layer.

params.name: first
params.desc: First page to read (1 is the first page).

params.name: last
params.desc: Last page to read.

params.name: layout
params.desc: Keep column layout instead of reflowing paragraphs.

params.name: output
params.desc: Markdown file or JSON {markdown, pages, total_pages}. Pages are separated by a line with ---.

params.name: ocr
params.desc: auto reads pages without a text layer by OCR; off leaves them empty and only warns.

params.name: lang
params.desc: OCR language(s) for scanned pages, e.g. deu, eng, fra or deu+eng.

ops.summary: Extract tables from a PDF to JSON or CSV (PDF table to Excel-ready CSV) — works on invoices, reports, bank statements. Billed per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF with a text layer that contains tables (for scans use ocr first).

params.name: first
params.desc: First page to read (1 is the first page).

params.name: last
params.desc: Last page to read.

params.name: output
params.desc: JSON {pages:[{page, tables:[[row]]}]} or semicolon CSV.

params.name: minCols
params.desc: Minimum number of columns for a line to count as a table row. Raise it to 3 or more if ordinary text is mistaken for a table.

ops.summary: Pages, title, author, dates (ISO 8601), PDF version, page size in mm, encryption, form and JavaScript flags as JSON. A password-locked PDF comes back with password_required true.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to inspect: page count, page size, metadata and other document facts.

ops.summary: Web page to Markdown/text: fetch a URL and extract the readable article — navigation and ads stripped, ready for LLM context or RAG.

params.name: url
params.desc: Public http(s) address of the web page to read.

params.name: selector
params.desc: CSS selector to read only part of the page, e.g. article or #content. Leave it out to read the whole page.

params.name: includeTitle
params.desc: Prepend the page title as H1.

params.name: waitUntil
params.desc: When to read the page. networkidle0: wait until the page has made no network requests for 500 ms; safest for pages that load content with JavaScript. load: read as soon as images, styles and scripts are loaded; faster, and the right choice for pages that never go quiet.

params.name: delayMs
params.desc: Extra wait after loading, in ms, up to 10000; use it for content that appears late.

params.name: output
params.desc: Markdown file or JSON {markdown, title, url}.

portal.blocked: Webadresse: das Portal wäre ein kostenloser Scraper und Proxy für jeden

ops.summary: Extract an e-book (EPUB) as clean Markdown for reading, summarising or RAG ingestion.

params.name: file
params.desc: E-book in EPUB format to turn into Markdown.

params.name: output
params.desc: md returns a Markdown file, json returns the Markdown inside a JSON object.

ops.summary: Read the bookmark/chapter outline of a PDF as JSON with target pages – chapter boundaries for clean RAG chunking.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to read the outline from.

ops.summary: Split text for embeddings: turn text/Markdown into RAG-ready chunks — token-based sizing, heading-aware boundaries, overlap, heading path and page metadata per chunk. The standard step before a vector DB.

params.name: text
params.desc: Text or Markdown to split into chunks for embeddings (or upload a file instead).
params.default_note: none, send text or a file

params.name: maxTokens
params.desc: Chunk size in tokens, 50 to 8000. 512 suits most embedding models; use the limit of your model if it is smaller.

params.name: overlap
params.desc: Tokens repeated at the start of the next chunk so no sentence loses its context; at most half of maxTokens.

params.name: splitOn
params.desc: heading starts a new chunk at every heading so chunks follow the chapters; paragraph fills chunks paragraph by paragraph up to maxTokens.

ops.summary: Extract text from a Word document: DOCX to clean Markdown — headings, lists and tables preserved.

params.name: file
params.desc: Word document in .docx format (for old .doc use office/pdf).

params.name: output
params.desc: md returns a Markdown file, json returns the Markdown inside a JSON object.

ops.summary: Extract text from a spreadsheet: XLSX to Markdown tables, one section per sheet.

params.name: file
params.desc: Excel workbook in .xlsx format; every sheet becomes a Markdown table.

params.name: maxRows
params.desc: Maximum rows per sheet, up to 20000; longer sheets are cut and marked as cut.

params.name: output
params.desc: md returns a Markdown file, json returns the Markdown plus details per sheet.

ops.summary: Extract text from a presentation: PPTX to Markdown — one section per slide, bullets, speaker notes included.

params.name: file
params.desc: PowerPoint file in .pptx format; every slide becomes a section.

params.name: includeNotes
params.desc: true adds the speaker notes under each slide.

params.name: output
params.desc: md returns a Markdown file, json returns the Markdown plus details per slide.

ops.summary: Encrypt a PDF with a password: AES-256 protection with print/modify/copy permissions — password-protect a PDF in one call.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to protect.

params.name: password
params.desc: User password (min 4 chars).

params.name: ownerPassword
params.desc: Second password that lifts the restrictions below. If you leave it out, the user password grants full rights, so set a different one when allowPrint, allowModify or allowCopy matter.

params.name: allowPrint
params.desc: Whether people who open the PDF may print it.

params.name: allowModify
params.desc: Whether people who open the PDF may change it.

params.name: allowCopy
params.desc: Whether people who open the PDF may copy text and images out of it.

ops.summary: Remove a PDF password: decrypt a protected PDF (requires the correct password; a wrong password returns 422 wrong_password). A file without password comes back unchanged and free.

params.name: file
params.desc: Password-protected PDF to open up.

params.name: password
params.desc: The password of the PDF. A wrong password returns HTTP 422 wrong_password and costs nothing. If the PDF has no password, it is returned unchanged, not charged, with a warning.

ops.summary: Visually compare two PDFs page by page: change percentage per page as JSON, or a diff PDF with changes highlighted in red. Billed per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: Two PDF files (field name "file", twice).

params.name: dpi
params.desc: Resolution for the page-by-page comparison, 50 to 200. Raise it to catch very small changes; higher is slower.

params.name: threshold
params.desc: How different a pixel must be to count as a change, 0 to 64 per colour channel. Raise it when scan noise or font smoothing shows up as changes.

params.name: output
params.desc: json returns a report of changed pages, pdf returns an overlay PDF with changes marked in red.

ops.summary: Redact or anonymize a PDF (GDPR): permanently remove names, addresses or any terms from contracts and reports — pages are rasterised, matches blacked out, the text is provably gone. Billed per page.

params.name: terms
params.desc: JSON array of terms to remove, e.g. ["name","IBAN..."] (max 100). A plain string is split at line breaks, or at commas if it has none. Terms that are not found come back as warning terms_not_found; if none is found, warning no_matches.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to redact (max 300 pages).

params.name: dpi
params.desc: Resolution of the redacted result, 72 to 300. Every page becomes an image so the removed text cannot be recovered; higher is sharper and larger.

params.name: padding
params.desc: Extra black margin around each match, in points, up to 20. Raise it if letters peek out at the edges.

params.name: requireMatch
params.desc: true: if none of the terms is found, return 422 no_matches_found instead of a PDF without any redaction.

ops.summary: Generate documents from data: Handlebars template + JSON to a finished PDF, PNG or HTML — invoices, reports, certificates. German helpers formatNumber and formatDate included.

params.name: template
params.desc: HTML with Handlebars placeholders such as {{customer.name}} or {{#each items}} … {{/each}}; filled with data and printed. {{x}} escapes HTML, {{{x}}} inserts it raw. Helpers: {{formatNumber amount 2}} gives 1.234,50 (German format, 2 decimals), {{formatDate date}} gives 6.10.2026. An unknown helper returns 400 template_compile_failed.

params.name: data
params.desc: JSON values for the placeholders in template. A placeholder without a value stays empty; the response lists such names in X-BigAPI-Warnings (missing_values).

params.name: format
params.desc: pdf for a document, png for an image, html for the filled page without printing.

params.name: pdf
params.desc: Page setup for PDF output, same options as render: format (A4, Letter …), landscape, margin, printBackground, scale.
params.default_note: A4 portrait, margins 20 mm top and bottom and 18 mm left and right

ops.summary: A Chart.js configuration → finished chart as PNG. All Chart.js types (bar, line, pie, radar, …), rendered server-side.

params.name: config
params.desc: Chart.js configuration {type, data, options}, e.g. type bar, line or pie, as in the Chart.js documentation.

params.name: width
params.desc: Image width in px, 200 to 3000.

params.name: height
params.desc: Image height in px, 150 to 3000.

params.name: background
params.desc: Background as a hex colour like #f5f5f5, or transparent for a PNG without background. Invalid values fall back to white.

ops.summary: Text or URL → QR code as PNG or SVG, with size, colours and error-correction level.

params.name: text
params.desc: Content (URL, text, vCard, …), max 4000 chars. What fits depends on ecLevel: at most 2953 bytes at L, 2331 at M, 1663 at Q, 1273 at H for normal text (UTF-8 bytes); more returns 400 text_too_long_for_qr.

params.name: format
params.desc: png for screens and documents, svg for print and any size without blur.

params.name: size
params.desc: Width and height in px, 64 to 2000.

params.name: ecLevel
params.desc: Error correction: how much of the code may be damaged or covered and still scan. L 7 %, M 15 %, Q 25 %, H 30 %; use H when a logo covers the middle.

params.name: dark
params.desc: Colour of the dark squares as #rrggbb. Keep strong contrast to light, or phones cannot scan it: below 3:1, or with dark lighter than light, the code is still made but X-BigAPI-Warnings warns. Invalid values fall back to black, with a warning.

params.name: light
params.desc: Background colour as #rrggbb. Invalid values fall back to white, with a warning.

ops.summary: Combine images into one PDF: JPG to PDF, PNG to PDF, merge scans into a single document — one or many images (max 200), auto page size or fitted to A4/Letter, EXIF rotation applied.

params.name: file
params.desc: Image files in order (field "file", repeatable, max 200); HEIC/HEIF from iPhones is accepted too.

params.name: pageSize
params.desc: auto makes every page exactly as large as its image; a4 or letter places each image centred on a standard page.

params.name: margin
params.desc: Margin in mm, up to 40; only used with a4 or letter.

ops.summary: Pull embedded files out of a PDF: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X invoice XML, attached CSVs, images or sub-PDFs — as JSON (text inline, binary base64) or a ZIP. E-invoice attachments are flagged.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF with embedded files.

params.name: output
params.desc: json lists the embedded files and marks e-invoices (ZUGFeRD, Factur-X); zip returns the files themselves.

params.name: name
params.desc: Return only the attachment with this file name.

ops.summary: Read XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X or Peppol BIS (XML or PDF) into clean JSON: parties, lines, VAT, totals, payment, profile and whether the format is accepted in Germany.

params.name: file
params.desc: E-invoice as XML (XRechnung UBL or CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML) or as PDF with an embedded invoice XML (ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, XRechnung hybrid).

ops.summary: Turn an XRechnung or ZUGFeRD/Factur-X invoice (XML or PDF) into a clean, printable PDF with parties, lines, VAT breakdown, totals and payment details — rendered without network access. German or English.

params.name: file
params.desc: E-invoice as XML (XRechnung UBL or CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML) or as PDF with an embedded invoice XML (ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, XRechnung hybrid).

params.name: lang
params.desc: Language of the labels.

ops.summary: Up to 50 e-invoices (XML or PDF) into one spreadsheet: one row per invoice plus a sheet with every line, amounts as real numbers. Or CSV for German Excel, or a DATEV booking batch (EXTF) with your accounts.

params.name: file
params.desc: One or more e-invoices, XML or PDF (field file, repeatable, max 50). Formats not accepted as an e-invoice in Germany (BASIC WL, MINIMUM, ZUGFeRD 1) are still listed, with the warning not_accepted_format; in xlsx, invoices without lines give no_line_items.

params.name: format
params.desc: xlsx gives two sheets; csv gives the invoice rows only, with semicolons and decimal commas for German Excel; datev gives a DATEV booking batch (EXTF format version 13, Windows-1252), one booking per invoice and VAT rate.

params.name: account
params.desc: datev only: expense account for incoming invoices (e.g. 3400 in SKR 03), revenue account for outgoing ones.

params.name: contra_account
params.desc: datev only: creditor (incoming) or debtor (outgoing) account, e.g. 70000.

params.name: direction
params.desc: datev only: incoming = supplier invoices (input VAT keys 9/8), outgoing = your own invoices (output VAT keys 3/2).

params.name: skr
params.desc: datev only: chart of accounts written to the header.

params.name: consultant
params.desc: datev only: DATEV consultant number (Beraternummer).

params.name: client
params.desc: datev only: DATEV client number (Mandantennummer).

params.name: account_length
params.desc: datev only: length of general ledger accounts (4 to 8).

params.name: fiscal_year_start
params.desc: datev only: start of the fiscal year, YYYY-MM-DD. Without it the calendar year of the invoices is used; invoices from two years are refused.

ops.summary: Check IBAN, Leitweg-ID (tells you the right check digits), EU VAT ID and Peppol participant ID (GLN, Leitweg-ID, VAT schemes). Structure and check digits only, no registry lookup.

params.name: iban
params.desc: IBAN, spaces allowed.

params.name: vat_id
params.desc: VAT ID with country prefix such as DE136695976.

params.name: peppol_id
params.desc: Peppol participant ID as scheme:value, such as 0088:4035811991014 (GLN), 0204:04011000-1234512345-06 (Leitweg-ID) or 9930:DE136695976 (German VAT ID). Structure and check digits only; the Peppol directory is not queried.

ops.summary: Validate XRechnung 3.0 and EN 16931 invoices (incl. ZUGFeRD) with the official KoSIT validator: every error with its rule. Up to 50 at once give one overview (JSON or Excel), duplicates marked; billed per invoice.

params.name: file
params.desc: E-invoice as XML (XRechnung UBL or CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML) or as PDF with an embedded invoice XML (ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, XRechnung hybrid). Repeatable up to 50: then you get an overview with summary (valid, invalid, not_checked, not_an_einvoice, duplicates) and one item per file; files that are no e-invoice are listed, not rejected.

params.name: output
params.desc: json lists errors, warnings and notes (with several files: summary plus items); pdf returns a printable validation report (one file only); xlsx returns an overview sheet and a messages sheet.

params.name: lang
params.desc: Language of the PDF report and of the Excel overview.

ops.summary: Convert an XRechnung or EN 16931 invoice between UBL and CII (also from a ZUGFeRD PDF). Only valid invoices; the result must pass KoSIT and map back to the same fields.

params.name: file
params.desc: E-invoice as XML (XRechnung UBL or CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML) or as PDF with an embedded invoice XML (ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, XRechnung hybrid).

params.name: to
params.desc: Target syntax: cii (UN/CEFACT) or ubl. Leave empty to get the other syntax of the input.

ops.summary: Invoice data (JSON) into an XRechnung or a ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3, or your own PDF plus data into ZUGFeRD. Totals and VAT calculated, KoSIT-checked; our PDF layout carries a GiroCode.

params.name: number
params.desc: Invoice number.

params.name: issue_date
params.desc: Invoice date as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: seller
params.desc: Seller: name, street, zip, city, country (default DE), vat_id or tax_number, email, phone, contact. XRechnung needs email and phone.

params.name: buyer
params.desc: Buyer: name, street, zip, city, country, email (electronic address for XRechnung), vat_id for reverse charge.

params.name: lines
params.desc: Items: name, quantity (default 1, up to 4 decimals), unit (piece, hour, day, kg, lump sum … or a UN/ECE code), price (net, up to 4 decimals), vat_rate (default 19 for German sellers, otherwise required), vat_category (S, Z, E, AE, K, G, O; default S). Discounts as an extra line with negative quantity.

params.name: format
params.desc: ubl or cii give an XRechnung 3.0 XML; zugferd gives a PDF/A-3 with factur-x.xml (profile EN 16931).

params.name: buyer_reference
params.desc: Leitweg-ID for public buyers, otherwise e.g. order or customer number. Required for XRechnung (falls back to order_reference).

params.name: due_date
params.desc: Payment due date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: delivery_date
params.desc: Delivery or service date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: payment
params.desc: iban, bic, account_name, reference. XRechnung needs an IBAN for bank transfer.

params.name: small_business
params.desc: true for German small businesses (§ 19 UStG): all items without VAT, with the legal note.

params.name: type
params.desc: credit_note gives a credit note (UBL CreditNote, type 381); add preceding_invoice {number, date}.

params.name: lang
params.desc: Language of the readable PDF (zugferd only).

params.name: order_reference
params.desc: Purchase order number.

params.name: prepaid
params.desc: Amount already paid; reduces the amount due.

params.name: note
params.desc: Free text note on the invoice.

params.name: attachments
params.desc: Supporting documents embedded in the e-invoice (EN 16931 BG-24), e.g. a delivery note or goods receipt record: [{filename, content (Base64), mime?, description?, id?}]. PDF, PNG, JPEG, CSV, XLSX or ODS, up to 10 MB each and 12 MB together. format=ubl takes up to 10; cii and zugferd take one (rule CII-SR-476). With zugferd the file is also attached to the PDF/A-3.

params.name: file
params.desc: Multipart only: your own invoice PDF. It stays the visible document; the invoice data from the field invoice is embedded as factur-x.xml and the PDF becomes PDF/A-3. Needs format=zugferd. If invoice number or total are not found in the PDF text, you get the warning pdf_mismatch; a PDF that already contains an e-invoice gives 422 already_einvoice.
params.default_note: none (then we create the PDF ourselves)

params.name: invoice
params.desc: Multipart only: the invoice data as a JSON string, the same fields as the JSON body (number, issue_date, seller, buyer, lines …).

ops.summary: Send e-invoices and one bank statement (CAMT or MT940): which invoices are paid, partly paid or open, and which payments match no invoice. Matches by invoice number, amount, IBAN and name.

params.name: files
params.desc: Up to 49 e-invoices (XRechnung or ZUGFeRD, XML or PDF) plus exactly one bank statement (CAMT .xml or MT940), in any order. Send each file as files.

params.name: direction
params.desc: outgoing: your own invoices, matched against money received; incoming: supplier invoices, matched against money paid (also by the supplier's IBAN). If no invoice matches in the chosen direction but some match in the other, the warning direction_mismatch says so; no_payments_in_direction if the statement has no payments that way.

params.name: output
params.desc: json for agents; xlsx with the sheets 'Rechnungen' and 'Zahlungen ohne Rechnung'.

ops.summary: Send one bank statement and the receipts you have (e-invoices, PDFs, scans, photos): each payment comes back as receipt found, missing or unsure, with the matching file. The list for the tax adviser.

params.name: files
params.desc: Exactly one bank statement (CAMT .xml or MT940) plus up to 49 receipts: XRechnung or ZUGFeRD, PDF, scanned PDF, JPG or PNG photo. Any order. Send each file as files. Scans and photos are read with OCR (up to 60 pages per request).

params.name: direction
params.desc: out: check money paid (supplier receipts); in: check money received (your own invoices); all: both.

params.name: lang
params.desc: OCR language for scans and photos (tesseract code, e.g. deu, eng, deu+eng).

params.name: output
params.desc: json for agents; xlsx with the sheets 'Zahlungen' and 'Belege'.

ops.summary: Strip the invisible: JavaScript, open-actions, form fields, embedded files and metadata (author, dates) are removed, the file is rewritten. sanitize_removed lists what went, nothing_found says it was clean.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to clean of JavaScript, auto actions, form fields and attachments.

params.name: flatten
params.desc: true bakes form fields and comments into the page so what they show stays visible but nothing is interactive any more.

params.name: removeAttachments
params.desc: true removes embedded files, which can carry malware or hidden data.

params.name: removeMetadata
params.desc: Removes title, author, producer, creation and modification date and XMP metadata. On by default since 2026-10-21; set false to keep them.

ops.summary: Optimise a PDF for fast web view: browsers show page one before the whole file has loaded — for document portals, archives and long reports.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to optimise for Fast Web View, so a browser shows page one before the whole file has arrived.

ops.summary: You already have the HTML: extract the readable article as Markdown — navigation, headers, footers, sidebars and scripts stripped. No browser, no network, milliseconds. The sibling of url/to-markdown.

params.name: html
params.desc: Raw HTML to convert (or upload a file instead).
params.default_note: none, send html or a file

params.name: mode
params.desc: article keeps the main text and drops navigation, header, footer, sidebars and forms; full keeps everything.

params.name: baseUrl
params.desc: Address of the original page; relative links become full links.

params.name: output
params.desc: md returns a Markdown file, json returns the Markdown with title and mode.

ops.summary: Compare two CSV or XLSX files and get the delta as JSON: added, removed and changed rows and cells, plus new and dropped columns — for price lists and inventories.

params.name: file
params.desc: Two tables in the field file, sent twice: first the old version, then the new one (CSV, XLSX or ODS).

params.name: key
params.desc: Column that identifies a row in both tables, e.g. id or article number.

params.name: sheet
params.desc: Sheet to compare in spreadsheet files, by name or number.

ops.summary: Turn SRT or WebVTT subtitles into a clean transcript: timestamps, tags and repeated lines removed, paragraphs at pauses; or JSON with start, end, speaker and text.

params.name: file
params.desc: Subtitle file in SRT or WebVTT format (.srt or .vtt).

params.name: output
params.desc: text gives a readable transcript; json gives every cue with start and end in milliseconds and the speaker if the file names one.

params.name: timestamps
params.desc: true starts every line of the text transcript with its time, e.g. [01:23]. Ignored for json.

ops.summary: Check JSON against a JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12) and get every error with its path, e.g. /items/2/price — for agents checking their own output.

params.name: schema
params.desc: The JSON Schema to check against; set $schema to the 2020-12 URL for draft 2020-12, otherwise draft-07 is used.

params.name: data
params.desc: The JSON value to check (object, array or any JSON value).

ops.summary: Convert PDF to Word: editable DOCX with real paragraphs and tables, not text boxes. Pure scans are read by OCR. Per page. Uses AGPL code, source: github.com/BiGapi-2026/bigapi-pdf2docx

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF to turn into an editable Word document. If no page in the range has a text layer (a pure scan), the text is read by OCR and returned as paragraphs, with the warning ocr_applied. Mixed documents keep scanned pages as images (warning no_text_layer). Password-protected PDFs return 422 encrypted_pdf, damaged ones 422 pdf_unreadable.

params.name: first
params.desc: First page to convert (1 is the first page).

params.name: last
params.desc: Last page to convert.

params.name: ocr
params.desc: auto reads pure scans (no text layer on any page, up to 50 pages) with OCR; off returns them as images like before.

params.name: lang
params.desc: OCR languages for scans as Tesseract codes joined with +, e.g. fra+eng. Same languages as ocr.

ops.summary: Convert PDF tables to Excel: every table found becomes a sheet, numbers stay numbers (1.234,56 and 1,234.56), percentages become percent cells. Billed per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF with a text layer that contains tables (for scans use ocr first).

params.name: first
params.desc: First page to read (1 is the first page).

params.name: last
params.desc: Last page to read.

params.name: minCols
params.desc: Minimum number of columns for a line to count as a table row. Raise it to 3 or more if ordinary text is mistaken for a table.

ops.summary: Turn every PDF page into a PowerPoint slide (page as image, same aspect ratio) to present or annotate a PDF. Text is not editable; use pdf/to-docx for that. Per page.

params.name: file
params.desc: PDF whose pages become slides, one page per slide, in order.

params.name: first
params.desc: First page to convert (1 is the first page).

params.name: last
params.desc: Last page to convert; at most 300 pages per call.

params.name: dpi
params.desc: Image resolution of the slides, 72 to 300. 150 is sharp on screens and projectors; 300 for printing the slides.

ops.summary: Convert between Office formats via LibreOffice: DOC to DOCX, DOCX to ODT, XLS to XLSX, XLSX to CSV or ODS, PPT to PPTX and back. For PDF use office/pdf.

params.name: file
params.desc: Office file: docx, doc, odt, rtf, txt, html, xlsx, xls, ods, csv, pptx, ppt or odp.

params.name: to
params.desc: Target format within the same kind of document: text (docx, doc, odt, rtf, txt, html), spreadsheet (xlsx, xls, ods, csv) or slides (pptx, ppt, odp). csv keeps only the first sheet.

ops.summary: Convert EPS and PostScript files to PDF (cropped to the bounding box) or PNG, e.g. logos from print shops. Files that try to read the disk are blocked.

params.name: file
params.desc: EPS or PostScript file (starts with %!PS) to turn into a PDF or an image.

params.name: format
params.desc: pdf keeps vectors and text sharp at any size; png gives an image of the first page.

params.name: dpi
params.desc: Resolution for png, 72 to 600. Ignored for pdf.

ops.summary: Read a CSV, Excel or OpenDocument sheet into JSON rows keyed by the header. Separator guessed (; , tab), German and English numbers become numbers.

params.name: file
params.desc: CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLS or ODS file to read.

params.name: sheet
params.desc: Sheet to read, by name or number (1 is the first sheet). CSV has only one.

params.name: header
params.desc: true uses the first row as field names; false returns every row as a plain list.

ops.summary: Decode CBOR (IoT, WebAuthn, COSE) to readable JSON or encode JSON as compact CBOR. Bytes come back as base64, large integers as strings.

params.name: file
params.desc: A CBOR or JSON file; the direction is detected from the content unless to is set.
params.default_note: none, send file, json or cborBase64

params.name: to
params.desc: Force the direction for an uploaded file: json decodes CBOR, cbor encodes JSON.

params.name: json
params.desc: JSON value to encode as CBOR (JSON request body instead of a file).

params.name: cborBase64
params.desc: CBOR bytes as base64 to decode to JSON (JSON request body instead of a file).
